invariants.text: Customer.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Account.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Account.customer_id must reference an existing Customer.id
A withdrawal is rejected if the result of the withdrawal operation would make the account balance negative.
A deposit increases the account balance by the amount of the deposit.
A withdrawal decreases the account balance by the amount of the withdrawal.
An account must belong to a customer, and the customer_id field must reference a valid customer in the Customer entity.
